display_name: Claim or refresh an agent role
description: Claim or refresh the role_binding row that binds an opaque role name (Coordinator, Architect, Git-Controller, etc.) to a peer session's current routing fields (agent_id, agent_instance_id, agent_session_id, session_label). v10 Control #2 makes role_binding the sole writable resolution and compare-and-swap authority; peer_send_by_name resolves it at send time. A vacant role, a dead-holder succession, or the current session's idempotent refresh proceeds normally. A different LIVE holder is protected by default: takeover=false returns role_held_live without mutation. Set takeover=true only after operator confirmation to authorize this one claim to displace the live holder; the authorization is never persisted, the displaced holder is notified, and the takeover is logged at WARNING with both identities. takeover=true with no live holder is an ordinary claim. The /rename skill calls this with identity fields obtained from peer_register; solet watch exposes the same one-shot escape hatch as --takeover.
embedding_description: Claim or refresh a durable role binding for Coordinator, Architect, Git-Controller, or another opaque role. Live holders are protected by default with role_held_live. An explicit operator-confirmed takeover=true displaces the live holder for this claim only, emits the handover notices, and is never retained for reconnects.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: action ('claimed', 'updated', or 'displaced'), name (the role), agent_instance_id, and agent_session_id. 'displaced' occurs only when an explicit takeover replaces a different live holder or when normal dead-holder succession replaces a prior binding.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the role and bound session. If action is 'displaced', state that the prior holder no longer receives role-addressed deliveries. Do not describe a queued handover notice as proof the prior model consumed it.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Uses StateManagementInterface-backed role and role_binding records. The live-holder gate runs before the claim CAS so a refusal mutates nothing. The stable agent_session_id is required for reconnect-safe ownership and may be sourced from the claimant's live peer_binding.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: role_held_live: a different live session currently owns the role and takeover was not explicitly authorized. missing_argument or missing_role_name: required claim identity or role input is empty. missing_session_id: no stable logical-session key could be supplied or sourced. system_slot_claim_denied: this caller may not claim the reserved sys: role. state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For role_held_live, confirm the intended handover with the operator, then retry once with takeover=true (or use solet watch --takeover for the arm-time claim); otherwise wait for release or holder death. A displaced watcher's next plain re-claim is refused loudly and its watcher exits rather than silently stealing the role back. For missing_session_id, relaunch with AGENT_SESSION_ID and register before claiming. Correct malformed or reserved-role input rather than retrying it unchanged.
